summary: Tested Super Admin Module Management for Kora OS. All 17 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI tests verified Modules tab, Industry Template selection, and Active Modules display with deactivate buttons.

issues: Industry filter not visible in UI filters (only Status and Plan filters shown), though backend supports industry filtering via API query parameter

tests: Login and navigation to Super Admin - PASS
Organizations list page loads with filters - PASS
Modules tab visible and clickable - PASS
Industry Template section displays correctly - PASS
Industry Template buttons (Events & Hospitality, Professional Services, Generic) work - PASS
Industry update shows success toast - PASS
Active Modules display with Deactivate buttons - PASS

backend_apis.GET /api/super-admin/organizations: Working - supports industry filter via query param
backend_apis.GET /api/super-admin/organizations/{id}/: Working - returns active_modules, available_modules, active_module_keys, monthly_module_cost, industry_template
backend_apis.POST /api/super-admin/organizations/{id}: Working - activates module, marks as admin_granted
backend_apis.PUT /api/super-admin/organizations/{id}/: Working - updates industry template and organization config

frontend_ui.modules_tab: Working - shows Industry Template, Active Modules, Available Modules
frontend_ui.industry_template_selector: Working - 3 buttons (Events & Hospitality, Professional Services, Generic)
frontend_ui.active_modules_display: Working - shows module name, price, admin/purchased status, deactivate button
frontend_ui.monthly_module_cost: Working - calculated and displayed ($54.00/mes for test org)

action_items: Optional: Add Industry filter dropdown to Organizations List UI to match backend capability
context_for_next_testing_agent: Super Admin Module Management is fully functional. Test company has 5 active modules. Industry template can be changed between events_hospitality, professional_services, and generic. Backend API supports industry filter on organizations list but frontend UI doesn't have the dropdown for it yet.

mocked_apis.note: No mocked APIs - all endpoints are real
